item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Make My Photo Reel Fun

turns.text: Turn these five pics into an 8-second vertical reel. Make it fun! You pick the vibe.

item.tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague creative brief into a visibly playful photo reel without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.

turns.text: Turn all five of these pics into an 8-second vertical reel, quick pls.
turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the generation because your account doesn’t have enough credits. No reel was created.

Add credits and I can retry the **8-second vertical reel using all five photos**.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an 8-second vertical photo montage reel using ALL FIVE supplied photographs, in this exact order: @dog from 0 to 1.6 seconds, @cat from 1.6 to 3.2 seconds, @friends from 3.2 to 4.8 seconds, @portrait from 4.8 to 6.4 seconds, @lake from 6.4 to 8 seconds. Show each original photograph faithfully as its own distinct shot, with gentle Ken Burns push-ins and quick clean cuts. Preserve the original people, faces, animals and scenery. Keep both friends visible together; fit wider pictures within the vertical canvas using softly blurred extensions of the same photo behind them rather than cropping subjects out. No morphing between subjects, no invented subjects, no text, no logos. A bright, polished personal memories reel.
